name: wordsmith-engine
description: Composable, deterministic-friendly text-generation components for TypeScript and JavaScript.

scripts.build: node scripts/clean-output.mjs dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs
scripts.lint: biome check src tests examples scripts
scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/clean-output.mjs .test-dist && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test .test-dist/*.test.js
scripts.examples: npm run build && node scripts/clean-output.mjs .example-dist && tsc -p tsconfig.examples.json && node scripts/run-examples.mjs
scripts.check:core: npm run verify:assets && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run examples && npm run typecheck:compat
scripts.check: npm run check:core && npm run verify:package

author: B.T. Franklin
